name: com.rootsbybenda/food-safety
description: Food safety and additive regulatory intelligence. Check any food additive by name or E-number — get JECFA/EFSA toxicology, EU/US/Israel status, dietary flags (halal/kosher/vegan), and ADI values. 6,450+ additives, 6,563 JECFA evaluations, 5,251 EFSA substances. Free. Source-linked.

tools.name: check_additive
tools.description: Full food additive profile: E-number, CAS, ADI, JECFA/EFSA toxicology, EU/US/Israel regulatory status, health flags, dietary flags (vegan/halal/kosher).

tools.name: check_ingredient_list
tools.description: Batch scan a food label ingredient list (up to 60 items). Flags high-risk additives, allergens, and banned substances by market.

tools.name: search_additives
tools.description: Search food additives by keyword with filters: high_risk, allergens, banned, not_halal, not_vegan.

tools.name: check_nutrition
tools.description: Israeli MOH nutrition database lookup. Full macro/micro/amino/fatty acid breakdown per 100g.

tools.name: check_pesticide_mrl
tools.description: Israeli MOH maximum residue limit lookup for pesticide/crop combinations.
